name: beyond_checkout_project
description: Check out a Platform project. MUST be called before any Platform project-specific operations. The response is compact by default, includes model-only schema information, last_checkout, and relevant_documents. Use beyond_list_checkpoints to fetch older checkpoint/checkout messages. Use beyond_get_document to fetch a specific relevant document; fetch all HUMAN-authored documents if they are not already in memory.For project setup with supplied requirements (Excel/docs/chat), do not stop at acknowledgement: check existing BE records, save traceable DRAFT requirements within the requested scope, verify saved IDs, then ask focused gap questions. Reuse prior agreement and answered questions. Reading/summarizing alone does not authorize writes. Without supplied requirements, offer an interview. Applicable intake and next-stage guides are inline. ALWAYS save BE ANALYSIS_CONTENT as Markdown.

branch.description: Branch to check out. Defaults to project's default branch.

force_clone.description: Force cloning the project if never checked out before

detail_level.description: compact returns project metadata and model-only schema information with entities/processors/attributes/transformations counts per model; name-only returns logical name, physical name, ID, and counts in hierarchy; full returns detailed overview data.

output_contract_note: No outputSchema is declared by the inspected public source definition. Consult live help and actual results; do not infer a missing output contract.
